desc:
Create a Battle Bot

🤖 BUILD IT. TRAIN IT. FIGHT IT! 🤖

Craft your own Battle Bot from a Drive Base, a Battle Body and an Assault Rig. Every part changes how your bot looks and fights, from spinning blades and scorpion stingers to roof flippers!

⚙️ BUILD: Collect parts, bring them to your Craft Station and bring your bot to life.
💪 TRAIN: Send your bot to the Push Machine to level up, even while you do other things.
💥 FIGHT: Take on boss after boss in the Crash Arena and earn cash for every run.
🏆 COMPETE: Enter the Underground Tournament and fight for prizes.
📦 COLLECT: Open crates for whole new bots, spin the Lucky Wheel and hunt for the rarest parts.
🔁 REBIRTH: Start your run again with bigger fight money. Your bots keep their level and parts!

Fill your Show Lot with your best creations and name each one. How far can your Battle Bot go?

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game for a cash gift!
